insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Specific Waiting Period up to 36 months for listed diseases/treatments (except accident).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured; proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room category chosen
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Associated Medical Expenses = nursing, OT, professional fees; pharmacy/consumables/implants/diagnostics/ICU NOT subject to proportionate deduction.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Coverage for treatment exceeding 3 days at home where hospital admission is not possible or unavailable.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH in-patient up to Sum Insured (except Yoga & Naturopathy)

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Newborn from day 1 (contingent on maternity benefit)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Basic Sum Insured (in addition to Limit of Coverage)
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Includes donor complications requiring redo surgery/ICU.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road actual; Air ambulance Rs 2,50,000/hosp, max Rs 5,00,000/policy period
ambulance_cover.notes: Air ambulance from place of first occurrence to nearest hospital.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured (refer schedule)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health Check-up benefit (limits per SI per claim-free year)

room_rent_capping: Single Private A/C Room or per-day cap per SI tier
icu_capping: No cap (no proportionate deduction on ICU charges)
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-payment with premium discount option. Age-based mandatory copay (per renewal terms).

disease_wise_sub_limits.home_care_treatment: 10% of SI or max Rs 5 lakhs per policy year

permanent_exclusions: Hazardous activities (skiing, skydiving, winter sports etc.)
temporary_exclusions: Specific waiting: 36 months for listed diseases/treatments
notable_exclusions_summary: PED 36 months; specified disease 36 months. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions. Hazardous sports/activities excluded.
claim_process_summary: Cashless at 14,000+ network hospitals. Reimbursement via insurer portal. Pre-authorization through TPA.
